title: Changing an entry's number on the Part Library page renames the part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin who can pick two locations in the location selector, {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBREN-01) is active at both {Location-A} and {Location-B}, on one Part Library entry.
  • The new number {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LIBREN-01N) is not used by any Part Library entry.
custom_steps:
1. Pick {Location-A} in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  3. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  6. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  7. Replace the Part Number with {Part-A} again.
  8. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  9. Click Save.
  10. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  11. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  12. Replace the search text with {Number-A}.
  13. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  14. Type {Number-A} in the Search box.
  15. Click the clock icon (tooltip "Part History") at the left of the {Number-A} row.
  16. Pick {Location-B} in the location selector.
  17. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  18. Type {Number-A} in the Search box.
  19. Click the clock icon at the left of the {Number-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: Under the Part Number field the dialog shows "This also changes the part number at 1 other location."
  • Step 7: With the saved number typed back, the message disappears.
  • Step 8: The message shows again.
  • Step 9: The change is saved and the detail page shows {Number-A}.
  • Step 11: No entry is found for {Part-A}: no new Part Library entry was created for the old number.
  • Step 12: One entry is found, {Number-A}.
  • Step 14: At {Location-A} the Inventory list shows the part as {Number-A} (the same part, with the same stock), and {Part-A} is no longer listed.
  • Step 15: Part History at {Location-A} has a new entry "Part number updated | Original number: {Part-A} | New number: {Number-A}" with your name, today's date and time, and no "Changed at" at the end.
  • Step 18: At {Location-B} the same part is listed as {Number-A}.
  • Step 19: Part History at {Location-B} has the entry "Part number updated | Original number: {Part-A} | New number: {Number-A} | Changed at: {Location-A}", with the name of {Location-A} as the location selector shows it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-R3a, S13-R16, S13-R17, S13-R18, S10-R23, S10-R25, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.2 (Both fields edited), board 2.4 (Part History at Heavy Duty), board 2.5 (Lethbridge: renamed there too), board 2.6 (Part History at Lethbridge), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R3a: “Changing an entry's number or description on its detail page follows the part dialog's rules: S13-R12 to S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7, and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R16: “When the user changes the part number and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." for one.”
  • S13-R17: “That message shows only while the typed number differs from the saved one, ignoring spaces before and after it. Parts at other locations count whether they are active or inactive.”
  • S13-R18: “Saving a changed number renames the part in place. The part keeps its identity, its history, and every line that holds it. Its Part Library entry is renamed with it, and its core takes the same number. No new Part Library entry is created.”
  • S10-R23: “A changed part number writes "Part number updated | Original number: {old} | New number: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part number changed on a part other locations stock): “"This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
